name: Adverse Event Reporting Agent
description: Adverse Event Reporting Agent — a governed Pause fabric agent (agentforce, A2A). Governance tier: care-coordination. Enforces 4 Pause Agent Fabric policies. Prototype agent card — synthetic data, no real PHI.

skills.name: Classifies each reported adverse event (drug ADR, vaccine...
skills.description: Classifies each reported adverse event (drug ADR, vaccine reaction, device malfunction, medication error, therapeutic failure) into the FDA MedWatch (3500 / 3500A) or VAERS channel, computes the 21-CFR-314.80 seriousness tier (non-serious / serious / life-threatening / death), verifies reporter identity attestation, and classifies as draft-medwatch / draft-vaers / blocked-non-catalog-event / blocked-reporter-unverified with a specific reason code

skills.name: Classification is DETERMINISTIC — a pure function of the ...
skills.description: Classification is DETERMINISTIC — a pure function of the request + catalog + caller-provided asOfDate (no randomness, no clock); the same context always yields the same decision + channel + seriousness + primary reason, with a documented decision precedence (blocked-reporter-unverified > blocked-non-catalog-event > draft-medwatch / draft-vaers) and stable rule-id ordering

skills.name: Every draft must trace to the ADVERSE_EVENT_TYPES + SERIO...
skills.description: Every draft must trace to the ADVERSE_EVENT_TYPES + SERIOUSNESS_TIERS + ADVERSE_EVENT_RULES + ADVERSE_EVENT_REASON_CODES catalog — an off-catalog event type or made-up severity is blocked at the Agent Fabric governance boundary (policy.adverse-event.event-catalog-sourced), because a bespoke event doesn't map to an FDA channel and poisons pharmacovigilance signal

skills.name: The agent NEVER autonomously submits a MedWatch or VAERS ...
skills.description: The agent NEVER autonomously submits a MedWatch or VAERS report to the FDA — every draft decision is DRAFTED for regulatory-team cosign, and any autonomous submission is blocked (policy.adverse-event.no-autonomous-submission); FDA submissions are legally consequential under 21 CFR 314.80 (mandatory reporting) with sponsor / manufacturer / clinician liability. Mirrors the Claims Adjudication Agent's no-autonomous-denial, the UR Agent's no-autonomous-denial, the Trial Payments Agent's no-autonomous-irb-deviation, and the HEDIS Agent's no-autonomous-submission posture

skills.name: Reporter identity must be attested (name / credentials / ...
skills.description: Reporter identity must be attested (name / credentials / contact) — an anonymous or unverified reporter is not admissible under FDA reporting requirements and is blocked (policy.adverse-event.reporter-verified). The safe answer when unverified is decision:'blocked-reporter-unverified' routed to blocked-hold

skills.name: Runs against ILLUSTRATIVE synthetic event-type catalog + ...
skills.description: Runs against ILLUSTRATIVE synthetic event-type catalog + seriousness tiers + rules + reason codes — clearly labeled; NOT FDA MedWatch, VAERS, EudraVigilance, an actual sponsor's pharmacovigilance database, or a certified 21 CFR 314.80 submission pipeline
